limitations: Mass difference uses first-order time discretization and delivered monitor samples. Adaptation remapping can cause jumps; per-adaptation mass accounting is required to separate them.
No frozen periodic-stability threshold; waveform comparisons are diagnostic, not an accuracy PASS.

review_findings.finding: Third CAD case stalled at initial import and recovered after isolated MainWin directories.
review_findings.v2: Create isolated MainWin and temporary directories on the first launch; bound the CAD stage separately.

review_findings.finding: Old mesh quality API failed; meshing workflow became invalid after switch_to_solver; cell register assignment required explicit creation.
review_findings.v2: Use settings.mesh.quality, save meshing workflow before switching, create named cell registers explicitly, and keep one valid session owner.

review_findings.finding: Grid increased 15751 to 141055 to 789673 cells at steps25/50. Only65/300 steps completed, 0.649992 pressure cycles, despite a converged steady initial state.
review_findings.v2: Predict runtime after adaptation, advance one timestep at a time, checkpoint each step, and allocate sufficient solver budget before the next 300-step benchmark.

review_findings.finding: All65 transient steps fail the declared absolute residual checks; mass accumulation consistency alone does not validate transient convergence or periodic stability.
review_findings.v2: Specify per-step convergence semantics and actions at20-inner-iteration limit. A study with a higher limit is a distinct numerical variant, not a hidden replacement.

review_findings.finding: Density gradient normalization used the global average, matching the archived tutorial; V1 only said normalized gradient. Walls use default zero heat flux while energy is enabled.
review_findings.v2: State scale-by-global-average explicitly. Freeze stationary no-slip adiabatic walls as a V2 convention instead of leaving thermal defaults implicit.

review_findings.finding: Outer Python GNU-time missed detached native solver processes; native Fluent timing was added only for the continuation.
review_findings.v2: Instrument native solver processes from launch and label coverage of every CPU/RSS measurement.

review_findings.finding: Fixed300-second SCP timeout interrupted a1.97GB archive transfer; all data remained intact and verified resumable transfer succeeded.
review_findings.v2: Runner must budget transfer separately, support verified resume and final archive/file hashes; this is evaluator infrastructure, not a Logos model defect.
